name: AdminThemes
description: Per-user admin panel theming. Full desktop-environment skins (macOS, Windows, Ubuntu/GNOME) plus the default Luminal look. Applies via a guarded head hook on every admin page; preference stored per user.
author: Luminal CMS
features: Per-user theme preference (server-side, keyed by user_id)
Full OS chrome skins: macOS, Windows, Ubuntu/GNOME Yaru
Default Luminal theme = current look, untouched (safe default)
Scoped, additive CSS overrides — base admin-styles.css never modified
FOUC-free: theme set pre-paint via head hook
Floating quick-switcher + visual gallery picker page
Site-default fallback for users who have not chosen
